resources.string: Log in with your Instagram account to download posts and reels. You log in on Instagram\'s own page; this app never sees your password.
Your Instagram session has expired. Please log in again.
Instagram wants to verify your account. Log in again and complete the check Instagram shows.
This account is private or you don\'t have access to this content.
Post not found. It may have been deleted, or it belongs to a private account you don\'t follow.
Instagram is limiting requests right now. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.
This doesn\'t look like an Instagram post or reel link.
Login could not be completed (Instagram session cookies missing). Please log in again.
Could not save the file to your gallery.
Paste a link, or share a post from Instagram to YzInsta.

Use this if the Instagram login page doesn\'t load. Log in to instagram.com in a browser on your computer, open the developer tools (F12) → Application/Storage → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com and copy the value of \"sessionid\" (or the whole Cookie header). This token gives full access to your account: never share it with anyone.
